description:
The front end compiles a guard into a presented part, which the holder proves off-chain,
  and a public part over groups and Issued, which the contract evaluates when the update
  executes. The contract computes the class of both. A nonempty presented part
  cannot be bound to an update, regardless of its class.

elements.name: exists x in S. Revoked(x)

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the policy 'exists x in S. Revoked(x)' is registered
the contract classifies the presented part as "state-independent" and the public part as "stable"
the front end computes the same classes
the policy is supported for issuance updates

name: The contract classifies policies and rejects unsupported update guards

description:
The landlord books the flat by revoking the winner's interest credential,
  but only while no member of the interested group S has been revoked.
  The contract evaluates that guard itself when the revocation executes.

elements.name: Without a bound policy the flat is booked twice

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
the guard policy is not bound to Revoke
Alice and Bob both prove the guard against group version 0
the landlord revokes Alice's credential
the landlord revokes Bob's credential
both revocations are accepted
the version of S is 2

elements.name: With a bound policy the contract rejects the second booking

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
the guard policy is bound to Revoke for the CredDef
Alice and Bob both prove the guard against group version 0
the landlord revokes Alice's credential with her guard
the revocation is accepted
the version of S is 1
anyone can verify Alice's guard proof from the ledger
the landlord revokes Bob's credential with his guard
the revocation is rejected with "GuardFalse"
Bob's credential is not revoked

elements.name: A stale guard proof is valid but not fresh

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
Alice's guarded revocation has been accepted
a verifier checks Bob's guard proof
the proof is cryptographically valid
it is not fresh because S moved from version 0 to 1

elements.name: A bound policy cannot be bypassed

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS

the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
the guard policy is bound to Revoke for the CredDef
the landlord revokes Carol's credential without a guard
the revocation is rejected with "PolicyRequired"
Carol's credential is not revoked

elements.name: The issuer cannot reserve the flat twice

steps.name: a landlord with a BBS key published in its DID document
a schema "Interest" version "1.0" with attributes "flat" and "name"
the landlord registers a CredDef for the schema "Interest"
a revocation registry for the CredDef with a published SRS
the landlord has issued interest credentials to Alice, Bob and Carol
the group S = {Alice, Bob, Carol} is anchored on chain
the guard policy "forall x in S. NotRevoked(x)" is registered
Alice's guarded revocation has been accepted
the landlord revokes Bob's credential without a guard
the revocation is rejected with "PolicyRequired"
the landlord revokes Bob's credential under the policy "exists x in S. Revoked(x)"
the revocation is rejected with "WrongPolicy"
the landlord revokes Bob's credential with a made-up guard proof
the revocation is rejected with "GuardFalse"
Bob's credential is not revoked
the version of S is 1
